title: Fire to Fire: Table Tools v1.9.4
description: Table tools for the Fire to Fire campaign (dnd4e): shroud counters (plus a shroud clicker in damage rolls) and an aegis ring on tokens, a conditions pop-up with 4e durations, power names on area templates, a special-ammunition drop-down in attack and damage rolls, a standard power icon picker, a Rules quick-reference sidebar tab (4e glossary), a mark-dead hotkey, Minion Groups in the combat tracker, and interface fixes. Includes the Fire to Fire stat-block character sheet.

recommends.reason: Supplies the 4e book fonts the character sheet uses.
